method: Normal normal maximum marginal likelihood separately for logit b and natural log ell; fixed mean per UTC calendar date; common nonnegative between span sigma; within errors are standard deviations of 400 transformed parametric bootstrap estimates
intervals: Profile likelihood 90 percent using chi square one degree threshold with zero included at boundary; 400 parametric hierarchy bootstrap intervals beside
source: data-model-01-v4.1.json and per job bootstrap files
future_date_limit: Fixed means for three UTC dates do not identify an unrestricted fourth date mean. The empirical day extension chooses among the three observed dates uniformly.
